domain: odd primes; prime 2 is an explicit unclassified exception

families.label: Irregular primes
families.criterion: There exists even k, 2 <= k <= p-3, with B_k congruent to 0 modulo p.

families.label: Regular primes
families.criterion: Every even k, 2 <= k <= p-3, has B_k nonzero modulo p.
families.stored_witness: Empty zero-index list; the complete nonzero residue sequence is retained and its series identity checked.

relationships.intersections_with_other_marks: Overlapping finite classifications; no infinitude status is inherited.
relationships.prime_web_background: The eight coprime residue classes modulo 30 from the earlier census.
